n01_to_same_R_L.exact_header:
theorem N01Properties.n04_exists_through03_preserving_correction_numerical_data
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {base loss : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hN : N01Properties D T S C base loss ε)
    (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S) (hT : IsMaterialData D T) :
    ∃ R : ReturnEquationData S, ∃ L : ReturnCorrectionData S,
      ∃ χ : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ, ∃ cell : ℕ → ℕ, ∃ base' : ℕ, ∃ ε' : ℝ,
        base ≤ base' ∧ 0 < ε' ∧ ε' ≤ ε ∧
          NonlinearPropertiesThrough03 D T S C R L base' loss ε' ∧
          L.coefficients = returnCorrectedCoefficients D S C χ ∧
          L.minusFlow = returnCorrectedMinusFlow S C χ ∧
          (∀ m, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (χ m)) ∧
          (∀ m r, r ∈ Icc (C.left m) (C.right m) → χ m r ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
          (∀ m, Function.support (deriv (χ m)) ⊆ Ioo (C.left m) (C.right m)) ∧
          (∀ m, χ m =ᶠ[𝓝 (C.left m)] (fun _ => 0) ∧
            χ m =ᶠ[𝓝 (C.right m)] (fun _ => 1)) ∧
          (∀ m, Ioo (C.left m) (C.right m) ⊆ D.cells (cell m)) ∧
          (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ B Q : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ 0 ≤ Q ∧ ∀ m r,
            |iteratedDeriv k (χ m) r| ≤ B * radialE (D.cellIndex (cell m)) ^ Q) ∧
          (∀ z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base' ε', ∀ m (p : PolarPoint),
            p.1 ∈ tsupport (deriv (χ m)) →
              0 < (originalCoefficients D S C z).b p ^ 2 -
                (originalCoefficients D S C z).a p *
                  (originalCoefficients D S C z).c p) ∧
      (∃ x δ : ℕ → ℝ, ∃ K A B lam P : ℝ,
        0 < K ∧ 0 < A ∧ 0 < B ∧ 0 < lam ∧ 0 < P ∧
        (∀ m, Ioo (C.left m) (C.right m) ⊆ D.cells (cell m) ∧
          0 < δ m ∧ C.left m < x m - δ m ∧ x m + δ m < C.right m ∧
          (δ m)⁻¹ ≤ K * radialE (D.cellIndex (cell m)) ^ A ∧
          ∀ r ∈ Icc (x m - δ m) (x m + δ m),
            radialE (D.cellIndex (cell m)) ^ (-B) / (2 * (D.b - D.a)) ≤ opticalSpeed D.w r) ∧
        (∀ m, χ m = returnOpticalCutoff (x m) (δ m / 2)) ∧
        (∀ m, tsupport (deriv (χ m)) ⊆ Icc (x m - δ m / 2) (x m + δ m / 2)) ∧
        (∀ m, tsupport (deriv (χ m)) ⊆ Ioo (x m - δ m) (x m + δ m)) ∧
        (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ Kₙ : ℝ, 0 < Kₙ ∧ ∀ m r,
          |iteratedDeriv n (χ m) r| ≤ Kₙ * radialE (D.cellIndex (cell m)) ^ (A * n)) ∧
        ∀ z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base' ε', ∀ m p,
          p.1 ∈ Icc (x m - δ m) (x m + δ m) →
          let d := lam * radialE (D.cellIndex (cell m)) ^ (-P) / 2
          0 < d ∧ d ≤ (originalCoefficients D S C z).a p ∧
          d ≤ -(originalCoefficients D S C z).c p ∧
          d ^ 2 ≤ (originalCoefficients D S C z).b p ^ 2 -
            (originalCoefficients D S C z).a p * (originalCoefficients D S C z).c p ∧
          0 < (originalCoefficients D S C z).b p ^ 2 -
            (originalCoefficients D S C z).a p * (originalCoefficients D S C z).c p) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base' ε', stateSector S z.1 →
        ∀ m r, r ∈ Icc (C.left m) (C.right m) → ∀ θ,
          1 / 2 ≤ deriv (C.minusFlow z m r) θ ∧
          deriv (C.minusFlow z m r) θ ≤ 3 / 2) ∧
      ∀ z ∈ sectorNeighborhood S base' ε' ε',
        ∀ m r, r ∈ Icc (C.left m) (C.right m) → ∀ θ,
          1 / 2 ≤ deriv (C.minusFlow (liftSectorParameter S C z) m r) θ ∧
          deriv (C.minusFlow (liftSectorParameter S C z) m r) θ ≤ 3 / 2

same_witness_strict_gap.supplier_header:
theorem exists_gap_neighborhood_for_positive_cutoff
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {base loss : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hN : N01Properties D T S C base loss ε)
    (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S) (hT : IsMaterialData D T) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (χ : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ → ℕ) {J A lam P : ℝ}
    (hJ : 0 < J) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hlam : 0 < lam) (hP : 0 ≤ P)
    (hcell : ∀ m, Ioo (C.left m) (C.right m) ⊆ D.cells (j m))
    (hcutoff : ∀ m r, |deriv (χ m) r| ≤ J * radialE (D.cellIndex (j m)) ^ A)
    (hpositive : ∀ z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε, ∀ m p,
      p.1 ∈ tsupport (deriv (χ m)) →
      let d := lam * radialE (D.cellIndex (j m)) ^ (-P) / 2
      0 < d ∧ d ≤ (originalCoefficients D S C z).a p ∧
      d ≤ -(originalCoefficients D S C z).c p ∧
      d ^ 2 ≤ (originalCoefficients D S C z).b p ^ 2 -
        (originalCoefficients D S C z).a p * (originalCoefficients D S C z).c p ∧
      0 < (originalCoefficients D S C z).b p ^ 2 -
        (originalCoefficients D S C z).a p * (originalCoefficients D S C z).c p) :
    ∃ base' : ℕ, ∃ ε' : ℝ, base ≤ base' ∧ 0 < ε' ∧ ε' ≤ ε ∧
      N01Properties D T S C base' loss ε' ∧
      ∀ z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base' ε', stateSector S z.1 →
      ∀ m r, r ∈ Ioo (C.left m) (C.right m) → ∀ θ,
        (deriv (χ m) r ≠ 0 →
          0 < (-returnCorrectedMinusSpeed D S C χ z m (r, -θ) -
            returnCorrectedMinusSpeed D S C χ z m (r, θ)) / 2) ∧
        returnCorrectedMinusSpeed D S C χ z m (r, θ) ≤
          -returnCorrectedMinusSpeed D S C χ z m (r, -θ)

Take hjets 1: J>0 and the first derivative bound. simpa only [iteratedDeriv_one,Nat.cast_one,mul_one] gives the exact hcutoff required by the public gap theorem. A>0 and P>0 supply their nonnegative hypotheses.
For r in tsupport deriv chi, hstripSupport puts r in Ioo(x-delta,x+delta), hence in the closed buffer. Apply the SAME hpositive to get lam*radialE(cellIndex(jm))^(-P)/2 lower for a,-c,Delta.
Call exists_gap_neighborhood_for_positive_cutoff hN1 hS hT hepsilon1 chi j hJ hA.le hlam hP.le hcell hcutoff hpositiveSupport. Only base2/epsilon2 are selected; chi,j,x,delta,R,L are untouched.

same_witness_strict_gap.field_header:
theorem N01Properties.n04b_opticalFieldRegularity
    (hN : N01Properties D T S C base loss ε)
    (hR : N02Properties D T S C R base ε)
    (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S) (hT : IsMaterialData D T)
    (χ : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hχ : ∀ m, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (χ m))
    (hχrange : ∀ m r, r ∈ Icc (C.left m) (C.right m) → χ m r ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hsupp : ∀ m, tsupport (deriv (χ m)) ⊆ Ioo (C.left m) (C.right m))
    (hend : ∀ m, χ m =ᶠ[𝓝 (C.left m)] (fun _ => 0) ∧
      χ m =ᶠ[𝓝 (C.right m)] (fun _ => 1))
    (hgap : ∀ z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε, stateSector S z.1 →
      ∀ m r, r ∈ Ioo (C.left m) (C.right m) → ∀ θ,
        deriv (χ m) r ≠ 0 →
          0 < (-returnCorrectedMinusSpeed D S C χ z m (r, -θ) -
            returnCorrectedMinusSpeed D S C χ z m (r, θ)) / 2)
    (L : ReturnCorrectionData S)
    (hL : L.coefficients = returnCorrectedCoefficients D S C χ)
    (hreference : ∀ m r, r ∈ Icc (C.left m) (C.right m) → ∀ θ,
      L.minusFlow (C.referenceState, 0) m r θ =
        θ - opticalTravel D.w (C.left m) r) :
    N04bFieldRegularity D S C L base ε

Rewrite the retained literal L.minusFlow identity, then apply hN2.n04b_returnCorrectedMinusFlow_reference hS hT chi m hr theta. This supplies the reference_flow field without any extra witness selection.
Apply hN2.n04b_opticalFieldRegularity hR2 hS hT chi hchi hchiRange hsupp_ts hend hgap L hLcoeff hreference.
